title: Harness repository, environments, seeding, evidence, gate and gateway route for the decision-log audit query harness
source: RWB-E2-005 legacy story sections 3, 13, 15 and 16; WP B-ITG-W2-01; Template and Rules v1 R7.2 and R9
section: 3 Preconditions; 13 Solution plan; 15 Screens and states; 16 Test cases
description: No source gives the harness repository and its pack versioning, the SIT and UAT environments it runs in, the way the six-entry case set of case RW-2026-000123, the 200 entries of rule R-LIT-03 at version LIT-2026.12 and the tampered entry 230 are seeded without the harness writing another service's schema, the per-run evidence format and its retention, the pass/fail gate that accepts a wave, or the path and merge order of the gateway-bff composite route through which the SCR-38 states are read. The story therefore writes the placeholder and states the assumption ASM-B-ITG-W2-01-E2005-1 wherever these values would sit.
evidence: RWB-E2-005 names the SIT synthetic set DL-AUDIT-01, the decision_log_entry indexes and the feature flag rwb.decision.audit-query, but names no harness, no evidence artefact and no gate; the architecture extract names gateway-bff as the only staff entry and DP-19 as the composite route, and gives neither the route path nor its merge order; ownership.json names the owners of decision_log_entry, approval, role, permission and recovery_case and no harness table.
proposed: The integration lead agrees the harness repository, the SIT and UAT environments and the seeding order with QA, fixes the per-run evidence format as one report per story and business date with one row per criterion, seam, answering service or fake, observed value and result, sets the retention to the release record, and agrees the gate as every owned criterion green with the three I stories in place; the platform edge owner publishes the composite query route path and merge order in the gateway-bff contract before the screen assertions of section 15 are run.

title: The harness repository, environments, seeding, business clock, evidence format and retention, pass/fail gate and the gateway-bff composite case-record route are not defined in the source documents
source: 22 Microservice Realignment/Recovery Workbench Architecture v5 Text Extract v1.md (slides 11, 20 and 44); 22 Microservice Realignment/Recovery Workbench Temporal and Drools Design Text Extract v1.md (slides 11, 28 and 31); 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epic 2 Story Files v5/RWB E2 004 Treatment entity and plan timers data model v2.md (sections 3, 13 and 16)
section: 3 Preconditions; 4 Flow; 12.2 REST operations consumed; 12.8 Contract fakes; 13 Solution plan (environment and test data); 15 Screens and states
description: No source in the set states where the wave 2 integration harness for this legacy key lives or which environments it runs in beyond the SIT and UAT names the legacy story uses; how it seeds the case, the treatment rows, the RESTRUCTURE package versions and the business clock that makes a due date of 2026-12-31 and a business date of 2027-01-01 reproducible; the format and the retention of its per-run evidence; its pass/fail gate; or the path, the merge order and the composition of the gateway-bff composite case-record route through which the treatment and plan sections, the timer view and the deviation view are read. Architecture v5 fixes the services, the schemas, the topics, the job map and the one-hop rule, and the Temporal and Drools design fixes the durable timer and the registry version, but none of the seven items above, so the harness can be built only against a stated assumption and the wave 2 run of record cannot be reproduced or audited without it.
evidence: Architecture v5 slide 11 gives the five call types, the 2 s timeout and the idempotency rule but no harness; slide 20 says gateway-bff composes at most a few parallel calls and never gives the composite case-record route path or its merge order; slide 44 retires JOB-05 and makes JOB-15 an Airflow trigger but names no test environment, seed set, evidence format or gate. The Temporal and Drools design slide 11 gives the shape of one service, slide 28 the failure behaviour and slide 31 a local demo stack (./scripts/dev.ps1 up), none of which is the wave integration harness. The legacy story RWB-E2-004 section 3 names a test harness in SIT and section 6 a controlled clock, and its section 16 a System level suite, but fixes no repository, no seed file, no evidence artefact, no retention and no gate.
proposed: Agree the harness pack with QA and the integration lead before the first SIT run: the repository and its pipeline, the SIT and UAT namespaces with `rwb.p3.plan-timers` on, one seed file per fixture (the three cases, the treatment of 36 installments and 850000.00, package RESTRUCTURE version RES-2026.12 with its five rows, the ten treatments of 2026-12-01) driven through the owners' contracts, the business clock as a harness setting, the per-run evidence report (one JSON row per criterion plus the run trace) attached to the release record and retained with the wave, the pass/fail gate (every owned criterion green and no cross-schema, second-hop or topic-name finding), and the gateway-bff composite case-record route path and merge order.

title: Customer other-products harness pack: repository, environments, seeding, evidence format, gate and composite route are not specified
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.5 (DP-05, DP-07, DP-08, DP-11, DP-15, DP-19), R7.2 and R9; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 8, 10, 11, 14, 15, 16, 29 and 41; legacy RWB-E2-003 sections 3, 12, 13, 15 and 16; _work/msr/plan/ownership.json
section: 3 Preconditions; 11 Data; 12.2 REST operations consumed; 12.8 Contract fakes; 13 Solution plan; 15 Screens and states
description: No source read gives the harness repository and the SIT and UAT environments it runs in, the way the run seeds case "RW-2026-000410" and case "RW-2026-000420", borrower "C-0410", account "A-0410", the products "A-0411" with status "ACTIVE" and "A-0412" with status "DELINQUENT", the account number "9900015678" and the role, scope and masking rule rows, the per-run evidence format and its retention, the pass or fail gate that decides the wave 2 acceptance run, or the gateway-bff composite case-record route path and its merge order for the other-products panel. The field IDs of the rwb_access entities (permission, masking_rule), of the rwb_case reference rows and of the rwb_source_data freshness tables are likewise absent from the legacy Data section. The legacy story gives the business values, the states, the rules and the messages only, and ownership.json gives the owners, tables, operations and events only.
evidence: RWB-E2-003 names the synthetic case set, the account number, the masking assumption DL26 and the feature switch rwb.integration.customer-products, but names no harness, no evidence artefact and no gate; Architecture v5 slide 10 describes the gateway merge of rwb-case and rwb-source-data with a response budget and slide 20 makes gateway-bff the only staff entry, without a composite route path or merge order; ownership.json gives no harness table and no harness workflow, and gives rwb-integration the activities deliverFile and receiveFile only.
